Do I need to install CS2?: Do I need to install CS2?
You can use the viewer in a supported br: You can use the viewer in a supported browser. Map and character assets are prepared by the instance operator; a 2D position view is available when assets or WebGL are unavailable.
Uploads are private by default. Only the: Uploads are private by default. Only the owner can publish a demo. Personal notes stay private even on a public match.
Can I use my phone or TV?: Can I use my phone or TV?
The interface supports touch and keyboar: The interface supports touch and keyboard controls, quality settings, and a low-power 2D mode. Actual performance depends on the device and installed map assets.
Does Steam sign-in download my matches?: Does Steam sign-in download my matches?
Steam verifies your identity and can sup: Steam verifies your identity and can support match discovery. Demo downloads from Steam’s Game Coordinator are not implemented; you can upload a downloaded demo. FACEIT downloads need approved API access.
Or take the sample for a spin: Or take the sample for a spin
A review room built around the match. Th: A review room built around the match. The controls you need stay close; the advanced tools stay out of your way until you need them.
Choose free camera, overhead, player per: Choose free camera, overhead, player perspective, or 2D tactical view. X-ray silhouettes, radar, and a centered crosshair help you read positions.
Get to the part that matters.
Round jumps, playback speeds, live-round: Round jumps, playback speeds, live-round navigation, timeout skipping, and player kill/death jumps make long reviews manageable.
Recorded grenade paths and event-based s: Recorded grenade paths and event-based smoke/fire zones help explain an execute. These overlays approximate game effects; they do not reproduce Source 2 smoke physics.
Signed-in viewers can save private times: Signed-in viewers can save private timestamp notes. Owners control naming, sharing, and deletion. Public viewers can watch without creating an account.

Choose a .dem or .dem.zst file. Uploads: Choose a .dem or .dem.zst file. Uploads are private by default, bounded by your instance’s limits, and processed in a separate CPU worker.
Steam sign-in links an immutable Steam I: Steam sign-in links an immutable Steam ID. With a configured API key, you can discover the next match sharing code. Automatic Steam demo downloads are not implemented.
cswatch verifies the FACEIT profile matc: cswatch verifies the FACEIT profile matching your Steam identity. Match history uses FACEIT’s Data API. Automatic demo imports require separate Downloads API approval.
Queued, processing, ready, or failed: a: Queued, processing, ready, or failed: a demo has a visible state. You can leave the processing page and return through your library.
Host cswatch behind your own reverse pro: Host cswatch behind your own reverse proxy. Keep the deployment CPU-only and choose the access policy that fits your players.

Public access and registration are indep: Public access and registration are independent controls. Environment values lock policy; unset values can be managed in the admin interface.
Docker Compose runs the web app and a ne: Docker Compose runs the web app and a network-isolated CPU parser worker. Persistent storage keeps accounts, originals, prepared playback, and notes together.
